title: Not telling family is best
author: cheyumaama
selftext:
Don't make the mistake I did and tell your family that you're developing your dream game. They will ask all the unnecessary questions including how much you're spending, how much your project hopes to make, etc. And then they will call you names, tell you that your project should be made with free "open-source" AI instead of paying for Opus 5.5 and other services, and then just put a damper on the whole thing ruining your mood and day. I was hoping to get help with an extra claude subscription, instead I got insults and shaming. That being said, you could be blessed with a very supportive family that trusts you and invests in what YOU believe is best for you, instead of what they think is best for you - which included pitching me a github co-pilot subscription and how everyone at their company uses it to code and that I'm a fool for spending money on a Claude max account. 

P.S. If you're in Ireland and have a job for me so that I can buy more claude accounts for my project, please reach out to me.
